slots.name: program count
slots.sentence: About 58 colleges and universities have live mascot programs, where handlers, veterinarians and students care for animals that have become part of campus history.

slots.name: tradition duration
slots.sentence: Yale’s bulldog tradition stretches back more than 130 years, connecting today’s students with generations of alumni who also considered Handsome Dan part of their Yale identity.

slots.name: handler tenure
slots.sentence: Haro has worked with him for more than five years and knows when his “social battery” is empty and it is time to step away.
